an6.45:2.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo iṇaṃ ādiyati. iṇādānampi bhikkhave dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhoginoti?
an6.45:3.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo iṇaṃ ādiyitvā vaḍḍhiṃ paṭisuṇāti. vaḍḍhipi bhikkhave dukkhā lokasmiṃ sāmabhoginoti?
an6.45:4.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo vaḍḍhiṃ paṭisuṇitvā kālābhataṃ vaḍḍhiṃ na deti. codentipi naṃ
an6.45:5.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo codiyamāno na deti. anucarantipi naṃ.
an6.45:6.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo anucariyamāno na deti. bandhantipi naṃ.
an6.45:7.1: iti kho bhikkhave dāḷiddiyampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino. iṇādānampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino. vaḍḍhīpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino, codanāpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino. anucariyāpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino. bandhanampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino.
an6.45:7.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu, hiri natthi kusalesu dhammesu, ottappaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu, viriyaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu, paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu,
an6.45:7.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo.
an6.45:8.1: sa kho so bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo, saddhāya asati kusalesu dhammesu, hiriyā asati kusalesu dhammesu, ottappe asati kusalesu dhammesu, viriye asati kusalesu dhammesu, paññāya asati kusalesu dhammesu, kāyena duccaritaṃ carati. vācāya duccaritaṃ carati. manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an6.45:9.1: so tassa kāyaduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati:
an6.45:9.2: mā maṃ jaññāti icchati, mā maṃ jaññāti saṅkappeti, mā maṃ jaññāti vācaṃ bhāsati, mā maṃ jaññāti kāyena parakkamati. so tassa vacīduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu …pe… so tassa manoduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati: mā maṃ jaññāti icchati, mā maṃ jaññāti saṅkappeti, mā maṃ jaññāti vācaṃ bhāsati. mā maṃ jaññāti kāyena parakkamati.
an6.45:11.1: tamenaṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā vippaṭisārasahagatā pāpakā akusalavitakkā samudācaranti.
an6.45:12.1: sa kho so bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā nirayabandhane vā bajjhati, tiracchānayonibandhane vā.
an6.45:12.2: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi evaṃdāruṇaṃ evaṃ kaṭukaṃ evaṃ antarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya yathayidaṃ bhikkhave nirayabandhanaṃ vā tiracchānayonibandhanaṃ vā’ti.
